about: The names a panel imports from @deepbuild/panel, DeepBuild's own module (#1425). `core` is the module itself: a view, an element, the layout helpers, the dock and DeepBuild's canvas. `components` is the catalog of toolkit components a panel may use, with their props and an example that renders. `not_offered` lists every other component the toolkit exports, with the reason it is not offered; `per_frame` marks one whose script runs per frame, refused at pack check and load. `from` says which toolkit module serves a name; only the app's loader reads it. The data a panel reads (needs_you, quotes) is the module's too, served by the app.

core.name: View
core.what: The class a panel's views extend: init(props, cx), render(cx).

core.name: div
core.what: A box element, styled by chained calls such as .p(8), .bg(color) and .child(x).

core.name: svg
core.what: An element drawing an SVG path or file, sized and colored like a div.

core.name: PathBuilder
core.what: Builds a vector path: move_to, line_to, curve_to, then fill or stroke it.

core.name: Background
core.what: A background beyond a plain color, such as a gradient, for .bg(…).

core.name: h_flex
core.what: A box laying its children out in a row.

core.name: v_flex
core.what: A box laying its children out in a column.

core.name: DockArea
core.what: The app's dock: DockArea.register_panel(slot, View) puts a view in a slot.

core.name: Canvas
core.what: DeepBuild's canvas: new Canvas(scene, color?) draws a CanvasScene's items.

core.name: CanvasScene
core.what: The items a Canvas draws, by ID, kept across renders: scene.set(id, values).

core.name: InputState
core.what: The text an Input holds, kept across renders: InputState.new({ placeholder }).

props.child: its label: text or an element
props.on_click: (event, window, cx) => void, called on your click

props.state: an InputState, given to Input.new(state), holding the text you type
